name: eICU-CRD
description: eICU Collaborative Research Database, about 200 thousand ICU stays across 208 hospitals. Mortality and length-of-stay MAE. Pollard et al., Scientific Data 2018. PhysioNet credential required. Records not vendored.
citation: Pollard et al., Scientific Data 2018. eICU-CRD.

license.notes: Credentialed PhysioNet access. Clinical records are loader-only and not vendored.
